heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Division 9—Change in ownership of international registration
text: If the trade mark is a collective trade mark, the Registrar must make a declaration in accordance with rule 27(4) of the Madrid Regulations that the change of ownership has no effect in Australia.
